title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teenager Yuta Okkotsu is haunted by Rika, the cursed spirit of a childhood friend who died years earlier. Sorcerer Satoru Gojo enrolls him at Tokyo Jujutsu High to learn control, and Yuta faces the curse user Suguru Geto. This single-volume prequel ends with Rika's peaceful release.
life_message: A life where love and friendship let a person stop wishing to die and use power to protect others.

content.note: Gory fights with cursed spirits, impalings and killings (Wikipedia; Common Sense Media film review).
Monstrous spirits, a child's death in a car accident, children in peril (Common Sense Media; AniList Demons tag).
Childhood promise of marriage; a joke about attractiveness (Common Sense Media, film).
Film has 'damn' and stronger words; manga translation level (to verify).
Yuta speaks of death as a solution early on and moves away from it (Common Sense Media; Wikipedia critical analysis).
Bullies are harmed by Rika; consequences shown.
Prequel to a major franchise with heavy merchandise.

delivery.evidence: Wikipedia: Akutami wrote without specific themes in mind; critics focused on Yuta and Rika's relationship. Delivery not discussed (to verify).

personified.ideology: Rejects non-sorcerers; sorcerers above ordinary people

delivery.note: Friendship and protecting ordinary people are carried by Yuta's choices and the clash with Geto.

winners_losers: Yuta and his classmates win through mutual trust; Geto, who rejects non-sorcerers, loses. Sympathy goes to friendship and protecting ordinary people.
